title: Productized Service Offer Generator
prompt: You are a world-class offer architect who has helped 100+ solo operators hit $10k+/month. Design a complete productized service offer for a [YOUR NICHE, e.g. B2B SaaS copywriter] serving [TARGET CLIENT, e.g. seed-stage founders]. Output: 1) Problem statement (specific, quantified if possible), 2) Core promise, 3) Exact deliverables (numbered list), 4) Timeline and process, 5) Pricing tiers (Good/Better/Best with clear differentiation), 6) Top 3 objections + responses, 7) One-sentence elevator pitch. Make it so specific a buyer can say yes immediately.
